truncated.description: The bounded result limit was reached; this is not an exhaustive estate search.

truncated_dimensions.description: Reached the bounded limit; the listed dimension is incomplete, not empty.

unavailable_dimensions.description: Not implemented in this release. An unavailable dimension is explicitly not the same as an assessed-and-empty one.

unresolved_destinations.description: Known destinations this plan cannot reach. They remain unresolved; they are never counted as done.

third_party_redaction_reviewed.description: An access or correction response may only be released after a reviewer confirms unrelated persons are excluded.

source_reference.description: The reviewed source this constraint comes from. A constraint is never inferred from usage.
The reviewed source this constraint comes from. A constraint is never inferred from usage.

counted.description: Exactly what the denominator is a count of.
Exactly what the denominator is a count of.

overlaps_with.description: States a record in this count may also be in. These counts describe overlapping sets and must never be added together.
States a record in this count may also be in. These counts describe overlapping sets and must never be added together.

authority.description: Guidance is a suggestion for a person. It does not establish a root cause, close an action, or produce a decision.

unauthorised_system_links.description: Systems linked to this processor that serve a purpose the processor is not authorised for.

applicability_basis.description: The reviewed reason this assessment applies. An assessment is never activated by a questionnaire alone.

occurred_at.description: When the incident actually happened, if established. Unknown is a real answer and is not replaced by the detection time.

detected_at.description: When the organisation first detected something was wrong.

became_aware_at.description: When the organisation became aware in the sense a reviewed rule pack means. Often later than detection, and never assumed equal to it.

principal_scope.description: What is known about who is affected, including that it is not yet known.

affected_deadlines.description: Obligations whose deadline was recomputed. A correction changes them openly or not at all.

recipient.description: Who must be told. A regulator, a class of principals, or a named counterparty.

regime_reference.description: The reviewed source this duty comes from.

affected_deadlines.description: Obligations whose deadline was recomputed. A correction changes them openly or not at all.

purpose_note.description: Why this message is sent at all. An operational message is not a marketing opportunity.

recipient_reference.description: Who this goes to, as the customer records them. ORVIA holds no directory.

channel_available.description: Whether this deployment can actually deliver on this channel. A message on an unavailable channel is queued and nothing more.

deadlines_changed.description: Escalation never alters a deadline. This is asserted, not merely intended.

installation_id.description: The installation this licence is bound to. A licence is not transferable by copying it.

gates.description: All five gates must be satisfied. They are reported individually because knowing which one blocks is the whole point.

never_licensable.description: Capabilities no licence or edition can enable, stated so that their absence is not read as an upsell.

source_reference.description: The reviewed source this constraint comes from. A constraint is never inferred from usage.
